NEXT PROGRAMME · 05Holiday Programmes

HERE TO HELP

GOOD
QUESTIONS.

Which programme is right for us?

Tell us who the programme is for, your sport and what you want to achieve. Our team can discuss the options for an individual player, preschool, school, club, community organisation or retirement village.

Do you offer more than football?

Yes. Football is at our core, and our coaches also deliver futsal, basketball, hockey, touch rugby and cricket, with netball and other sports in our holiday programmes. Get in touch with your sport and the coaching you need.

How big is the Proteus team?

Nearly 60 coaches delivered programmes across Christchurch in the first quarter of 2026, supporting hundreds of athletes every week across schools, clubs, early learning centres and community programmes.

How do I express interest in the 2027 Academy?

Email info@proteus.nz for any of our six Academy sports. Include your name and age, sport, school, and current team or club. The team will be in touch to discuss the next steps.

Where can I find holiday dates and registration details?

Contact oliver@proteus.nz for upcoming holiday programmes, locations and registration information. Programme details vary, so check the information for the specific camp before booking.

Can Proteus help our organisation beyond coaching?

Yes. Alongside coaching we offer operational support and sports business capability: strategic and governance support, sports management and recruitment, sports marketing and promotion, and organisational development to help you build sustainable programmes.

What is it like to coach with Proteus?

You join a network of 60+ coaches with quick onboarding into sessions, reliable fortnightly payments and a strong focus on support and retention. We help coaches gain experience, develop professionally and find pathways into the industry.

How can our school or club work with Proteus?

Contact patrick@proteus.nz with your organisation, the sport or activity, the group you want to support and your goals. We can discuss coaching and programme options that fit your needs.
